# One character away from the suite next door: 10 became 11. The subject is
# byte for byte the same file and the mutant is the same mutant, and a suite
# that looks one past the boundary never sees `<` become `<=`.
#
# This is the near-miss the pair exists for. A neighbour that asserted nothing
# at all would also let the mutant live, and it would prove only that an empty
# suite kills nothing.

import guard

assert guard.admits(9) is True
assert guard.admits(11) is False
